verdict.rationale: Synctera's docs confirm that cards can be issued, activated and managed for customers through the same platform API that handles accounts and transfers (docs-4, docs-7). Card offerings are also marketed (docs-30), but the evidence is only thin summary lines. Missing for 10: explicit virtual vs. physical debit card issuance, documented linkage of cards to DDA accounts, spend controls/limits, digital wallet (Apple/Google Pay) provisioning, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
